description.value: The study investigated the cognitive and anatomic basis of quantifier and object noun production in semi-structured speech in patients with focal neurodegenerative disease and healthy seniors, using gray-matter and white-matter neuroimaging analyses.

spans.text: We examined the cognitive and anatomic basis for the spontaneous speech production of quantifiers and object nouns in non-aphasic patients with focal neurodegenerative disease

description.value: Retrospective observational study of patients with CBS, bvFTD, and svPPA and healthy seniors; behavioral speech testing and MRI were collected, with MRI obtained within an average of 105 days of behavioral testing.

description.value: Semi-structured speech-production task in which participants described the Cookie Theft picture from the Boston Diagnostic Aphasia Examination. Participants described the picture in as much detail as possible for 90 or 60 seconds while examiners minimized prompts.

instructions.value: Describe the picture in as much detail as possible for a specified amount of time.

stimuli.value: Cookie Theft picture from the Boston Diagnostic Aphasia Examination, depicting children reaching for a cookie jar while their mother washes overflowing dishes.
